sentences.text: Alnus glutinosa is pollinated by wind.
In Mainz-Bingen it has been reported throughout the year over the past decade, with the most reports recorded in December.
The European goldfinch and, in two records, the musk beetle are recorded as predators.
It is recorded as a host for the fungi Turkeytail, Tinder Bracket, Red-Belted Bracket and Candlesnuff Fungus.
It is also recorded as a host for the moths Dotted Border and Lime Hawk-Moth.
